chapter_title_en: The Skull in the Death Swamp
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch 342: A Skull Awakens in the Swamp
chapter_meta_description: In a death-still swamp on Dragon Island, a human skull awakens and begins to absorb soul fires, growing from a spark into a self-aware undead warrior. A story of patience and survival in the realm of the dead.
og_title: A Spark in the Swamp: The Birth of an Undead King
og_description: Chapter 342: Ten years of silence in the swamp of bones. Then a skull moves, learning to steal the fires of the dead to forge its own path.
twitter_description: Deep in a misty swamp, a human skull awakens. It learns to absorb the soul fires of other undead, painstakingly growing stronger. A new consciousness is born in the World of Immortality.
